title: FishingEvolution
description: Basic Fishing Rod & Upgradeable Fishing Rod
body:
# FishingEvolution

FishingEvolution transforms Minecraft fishing into a complete progression system. Instead of using multiple custom rods, players level up a single upgradeable fishing rod through XP, upgrades, competitions, and rewards.

Built for survival, skyblock, RPG, and economy servers, FishingEvolution adds long-term progression while keeping vanilla fishing simple and enjoyable.

## Features

### Upgradeable Fishing Rod

* One evolving fishing rod system
* No durability loss
* Custom rod levels and progression
* Upgrade GUI (Sneak + Right Click)
* Persistent player statistics
* Hidden plugin data to prevent conflicts with normal rods

### Fishing XP System

Earn XP by catching fish:

* Cod
* Salmon
* Tropical Fish
* Pufferfish

Track:

* Current XP
* Required XP
* Fish caught
* Rod level
* Upgrade levels

### Upgrade Paths

#### Bait

Increase XP gained from fishing.

#### Food

Restore hunger and saturation while fishing.

#### Treasure

Unlock bonus fishing rewards and improved loot chances.

#### Mastery

Gain critical XP bonuses and unlock smithing template rewards.

### Smithing Template Rewards

Mastery upgrades can unlock rare smithing template drops.

Features:

* Configurable template weights
* Rare Netherite Upgrade Template rewards
* Optional template protection
* Optional duplication prevention

### Fish-Only Fishing

Keep fishing clean and focused.

Blocked junk rewards:

* Books
* Enchanted Books
* Maps
* Bows
* Saddles
* Other unwanted vanilla junk

### Economy Integration

Vault supported.

Sell fish using:

```
/fish sell
```

Includes:

* Sell GUI
* Configurable fish prices
* Economy compatibility

### Fishing Areas

Create custom fishing zones.

Commands:

```
/fish area set <radius>
/fish area remove
/fish editor
/pos confirm
```

Features:

* Water detection
* Fishing zone restrictions
* Particle visualization

### Weekend Fishing Competitions

Create engaging weekend events.

Features:

* Automatic competition scheduling
* Catch tracking
* Top player rankings
* NPC leaderboard support

Command:

```
/fish npc show
```

### Anti-AFK Protection

Prevent automated fishing abuse.

Detects:

* Repeated catches from one location
* Extended inactivity
* Suspicious fishing patterns

Permission:

```
fishingevolution.alerts
```

### PlaceholderAPI Support

Available placeholders:

```
%fishingevolution_level%
%fishingevolution_xp%
%fishingevolution_required_xp%
%fishingevolution_progress%
%fishingevolution_fish_caught%
%fishingevolution_bait_level%
%fishingevolution_food_level%
%fishingevolution_treasure_level%
%fishingevolution_mastery_level%
```

### ItemsAdder Compatibility

Automatic ItemsAdder detection for future custom texture and item support.

### Modrinth Update Checker

Built-in Modrinth update checker with configurable intervals.

## Commands

```
/fish
/fish give [player]
/fish reload
/fish info
/fish sell
/fish editor
/fish area set <radius>
/fish area remove
/fish npc show
/fish testcatch <fish>
/pos confirm
```

## Configuration Files

* config.yml
* xp.yml
* gui.yml
* messages.yml
* data.yml

## Requirements

* Paper / Spigot 1.21+
* Vault (Optional)
* PlaceholderAPI (Optional)
* ItemsAdder (Optional)

## Summary

FishingEvolution turns Minecraft fishing into a complete progression experience with leveling, upgrades, economy integration, competitions, anti-AFK protection, and customizable rewards.

Perfect for Survival, Skyblock, RPG, and Economy servers.
